messages:
emma: idea: can we build a tiny internal LLM that writes short, extremely specific kudos for teammates? Like micro-praise for weird helpful things. :sparkles: 

raj: yes but give it constraints or we'll get 12-line sonnets about PR titles. :sweat_smile:

olivia: prompt draft: `You are PraisePal. When asked, generate a 1-2 sentence workplace kudos that mentions a concrete action, a playful emoji, and one quirky personal detail. Keep it warm and never mention salary.` Example: 'Thanks @raj for sprinting on the release train. You saved the team's sanity 🎟️ — coffee owed!'`

emma: love it. bonus rule: never use the word "perfect". too corporate.

praisepal-bot: quick test: `@praisepal write kudos for @olivia` -> "Olivia spotted a flaky test and fixed it before anyone had coffee ☕️. Your stealth debugging saved our morning — hero cape pending." :tada:

raj: that one's good. small tweak: make it optional to include a small goofy prize like 'one office cupcake' or 'one cheery meme' so we don't accidentally promise money.

olivia: also maybe add a guardrail for weird privacy things. don't repeat private messages.

emma: ops check: infra-bot, can we run PraisePal as a morning digest in #general? one auto-kudos per day?

infra-bot: FYI: automated messages to #general require ops review and opt-out toggle per person. Also rate limit = 1/kudos per 24h.

raj: poll: enable digest? 1) yes 2) no 3) only if we can edit before posting

emma: 3

olivia: 1 (I love office cupcakes)

raj: 3

praisepal-bot: note: test run produced one unexpected output: "Shoutout to @harry for managing to not break the microwave this week 🥳 — we believe in you." Please confirm micro-jokes are OK.

emma: omg that's peak office humor. approved if it's loving and not passive-aggressive.

olivia: final feature request: allow people to submit micro-prompts like "kudos for helping with Docker" and get back 3 variations. winners get sticker.

infra-bot: deployment note: staging deploy succeeded. production scheduled after ops review. logs: `kudos-gen v0.1 warmstart OK`

emma: perfect. next step: name the sticker. options: 1) PraisePal ribbon 2) Micro-Kudos badge 3) I survived a flaky test

raj: 1

olivia: 2

emma: 3 (memes over ribbons)

infra-bot: votes recorded: 1,2,3. Tally inconclusive. Suggest design team run a quick mock and we vote again.

raj: can someone please ensure PraisePal never invents tasks people didn't do. guardrails are sacred. :pray:
